name: Apple
extract: The round, edible pomaceous fruit of an apple tree, with crisp flesh, thin skin, seeds, and sweet taste.

name: Oak
extract: A large deciduous hardwood tree of genus Quercus with deeply lobed leaves, acorns, and durable dense wood.

name: Wolf
extract: A carnivorous wild canine mammal living in social packs, possessing sharp teeth, fur, and predatory instincts.

name: Mushroom
extract: The fleshy, spore-bearing fruiting body of a fungus, typically produced above ground on soil or its food source.

name: Wheat
extract: A cereal grain grass cultivated globally for its edible starchy seeds, milled into flour for human food.

name: Honeybee
extract: A social flying insect that produces honey and beeswax, pollinating flowering plants with winged flight.

name: Salmon
extract: An anadromous migratory fish with pink flesh, swimming upstream to spawn in freshwater rivers.

name: Rose
extract: A woody perennial flowering plant of genus Rosa, with thorny stems, fragrant red petals, and ornamental flowers.

name: Whale
extract: A massive aquatic marine mammal breathing air through a blowhole, swimming through ocean depths.

name: Bacteria
extract: Microscopic single-celled prokaryotic microorganisms lacking a nucleus, reproducing rapidly by cell division.

name: Pine
extract: An evergreen coniferous tree with needle-shaped leaves, cones containing seeds, and aromatic resinous wood.

name: Spider
extract: An eight-legged predatory arthropod producing silk threads to spin webs for capturing insect prey.

name: Eagle
extract: A large bird of prey with keen eyesight, hooked beak, and powerful talons hunting small animals.

name: Carrot
extract: A biennial root vegetable, typically orange, crisp, and fibrous, rich in beta-carotene and dietary nutrients.

name: Potato
extract: A starchy tuberous root vegetable of Solanum tuberosum, growing underground as a major human carbohydrate food.

name: Yeast
extract: Eukaryotic single-celled fungi capable of fermenting sugars into alcohol and carbon dioxide in baking and brewing.

name: Grass
extract: Monocotyledonous herbaceous plants with narrow leaves growing from the base, forming ground pastures and lawns.

name: Horse
extract: A large domesticated four-legged herbivorous mammal with hooves, used for transport, riding, and draft work.

name: Shark
extract: A predatory cartilaginous fish with multiple gill slits, triangular sharp teeth, and streamlined hydrodynamic body.

name: Tomato
extract: The glossy red edible berry of Solanum lycopersicum, containing juicy pulp and seeds, used in cuisine.

name: Orange
extract: A round citrus fruit with a fragrant textured rind, segmented juicy pulp, and sweet-acidic vitamin C juice.

name: Bamboo
extract: A fast-growing woody perennial evergreen grass with hollow stems, immense tensile strength, and fibrous stalks.

name: Ant
extract: A colonial eusocial insect living in underground mounds with complex division of labor and high collective organization.

name: Elephant
extract: The largest terrestrial mammal, possessing a long prehensile muscular trunk, large ears, and ivory tusks.

name: Coral
extract: Marine invertebrate animals living in compact colonies of polyps, secreting calcium carbonate hard exoskeletons.

name: Hammer
extract: A handheld manual striking tool consisting of a heavy metal head mounted perpendicularly on a rigid handle.

name: Knife
extract: A cutting tool or handheld weapon with an exposed sharp edged blade affixed to an ergonomic handle.

name: Lever
extract: A rigid beam pivoted at a fixed fulcrum used to amplify mechanical force and lift heavy loads.

name: Wheel
extract: A circular mechanical component rotating on an axle, reducing friction to transport vehicles or transfer torque.

name: Anvil
extract: A heavy forged steel block with a flat working surface upon which hot metals are hammered and shaped.

name: Telescope
extract: An optical instrument using lenses or curved mirrors to magnify distant astronomical celestial bodies.

name: Microscope
extract: An optical device with compound lenses to produce magnified visual images of microscopic specimens.

name: Engine
extract: A machine designed to convert thermal, chemical, or electrical energy into mechanical work and motion.

name: Battery
extract: An electrochemical storage device that converts stored chemical potential energy into electrical current.

name: Transistor
extract: A solid-state semiconductor electronic device used to amplify or switch electrical signals and power.

name: Compass
extract: A navigational instrument with a magnetized needle pointing toward the Earth's magnetic north pole.

name: Clock
extract: A mechanical or electronic timekeeping instrument measuring, displaying, and synchronizing hours and minutes.

name: Laser
extract: A device that emits a coherent, monochromatic, collimated beam of electromagnetic light radiation.

name: Turbine
extract: A rotary mechanical machine that extracts kinetic energy from a fluid flow (gas, steam, water) into shaft work.

name: Computer
extract: A programmable digital electronic machine that executes algorithmic instructions, processing data and code.

name: Resistor
extract: A passive two-terminal electronic component that implements electrical resistance as a circuit element.

name: Capacitor
extract: A passive electrical component consisting of two conducting plates storing energy in an electrostatic field.

name: Antenna
extract: An electrical transducer device that converts radio frequency electromagnetic currents into radiating radio waves.

name: Pump
extract: A mechanical apparatus used to move fluids (liquids or gases) by positive displacement or centrifugal mechanical action.

name: Gear
extract: A toothed wheel that meshes with another to transmit torque, change speed, or alter rotational direction.

name: Screwdriver
extract: A handheld tool with a shaped tip fitting into a screw head to turn, drive, or remove threaded fasteners.

name: Mirror
extract: A reflective planar or curved glass surface with a metallic backing reflecting visible light rays specularly.

name: Lens
extract: A transparent optical glass element with curved surfaces that refracts light beams to converge or diverge.

name: Transformer
extract: A passive electrical device transferring alternating electrical power between circuits through electromagnetic induction.

name: Dynamo
extract: An electrical generator that converts mechanical shaft rotation into direct current electricity using magnetic coils.

name: Lightning
extract: A high-voltage electrostatic discharge phenomenon between clouds or ground, producing plasma and thunder.

name: Thunder
extract: The loud acoustic acoustic shockwave produced by the rapid thermal expansion of air heated by lightning plasma.

name: Rain
extract: Liquid water droplets condensing from atmospheric water vapor and falling under gravity onto Earth's surface.

name: Fire
extract: The visible exothermic chemical oxidation process of combustion, releasing heat, light, flames, and smoke.

name: Earthquake
extract: A sudden violent seismic shaking of the ground caused by the release of kinetic energy along geological faults.

name: Tornado
extract: A violently rotating column of air in contact with both the earth surface and a cumulonimbus cloud.

name: Glacier
extract: A persistent massive body of dense ice moving slowly downhill under its own gravitational weight.

name: Aurora
extract: A natural light display in high-latitude skies caused by solar wind particles colliding with magnetospheric gases.

name: Rainbow
extract: An optical meteorological phenomenon displaying a spectrum of light in the sky caused by reflection and refraction in rain.

name: Tsunami
extract: A series of immense water ocean waves caused by underwater earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, or landslides.

name: Volcano
extract: A geological rupture in the planetary crust through which molten lava, volcanic ash, and hot gases erupt.

name: Fog
extract: A dense low-lying cloud of water droplets suspended in the air near the ground, reducing visual visibility.

name: Wind
extract: The perceptible natural movement of air currents flowing from areas of high atmospheric pressure to low pressure.

name: Combustion
extract: A high-temperature exothermic chemical reaction between a fuel and an oxidant producing heat and flue gas.

name: Evaporation
extract: The thermodynamic phase transition process by which liquid molecules gain kinetic energy and escape into gas.

name: Condensation
extract: The physical change of state where a gas or vapor transitions into a liquid upon cooling.

name: Geyser
extract: A natural hot spring that intermittently discharges boiling hot water and steam violently into the atmosphere.

name: Eclipse
extract: An astronomical alignment phenomenon where one celestial body passes into the shadow cast by another.

name: Avalanche
extract: A rapid downhill flow of a massive volume of snow, ice, and rock debris tumbling down a steep mountain slope.

name: Rust
extract: The reddish-brown iron oxide compound formed by the electrochemical oxidation of iron in moisture and oxygen.

name: Decay
extract: The biological breakdown and organic decomposition of dead matter by bacteria and fungi into simple minerals.

name: Freezing
extract: The phase transition where a liquid cools below its freezing point and crystallizes into a solid state.

name: Boiling
extract: The rapid thermodynamic vaporization of a liquid occurring when vapor pressure equals surrounding ambient pressure.

name: Magnetism
extract: A physical fundamental force mediated by magnetic fields produced by electric currents and magnetic dipoles.

name: Gravitation
extract: The universal fundamental physical interaction where all masses and energy attract one another in spacetime.

name: Water
extract: A transparent odorless liquid chemical substance of formula H2O forming streams, lakes, oceans, and living fluid.

name: Iron
extract: A dense, silvery-grey ferromagnetic transition metal element (Fe), easily forged and vital in industrial steel.

name: Gold
extract: A precious dense, malleable, and ductile yellow metallic element (Au), resistant to chemical corrosion and tarnish.

name: Diamond
extract: A solid metastable allotrope of pure carbon with atoms arranged in a crystal lattice, possessing extreme hardness.

name: Oxygen
extract: A colorless odorless gaseous chemical element (O2) essential for aerobic cellular respiration and combustion.

name: Hydrogen
extract: The lightest, most abundant chemical element in the universe, a colorless flammable diatomic gas (H2).

name: Carbon
extract: A nonmetallic tetravalent chemical element forming the chemical basis of all known organic life forms.

name: Quartz
extract: A hard crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms in a continuous SiO4 framework.

name: Granite
extract: A coarse-grained intrusive felsic igneous rock composed predominantly of quartz, feldspar, and mica minerals.

name: Basalt
extract: A dense dark extrusive igneous volcanic rock formed by the rapid cooling of basaltic lava on oceanic crust.

name: Copper
extract: A soft, malleable reddish-orange transition metal element with extremely high electrical and thermal conductivity.

name: Silver
extract: A lustrous white precious transition metal element exhibiting the highest electrical conductivity of any metal.

name: Silicon
extract: A hard, brittle crystalline semiconductor metalloid element used as the foundation for modern microchips.

name: Salt
extract: A crystalline mineral composed primarily of sodium chloride (NaCl), an essential biological nutrient and seasoning.

name: Sulfur
extract: A bright yellow nonmetallic crystalline chemical element forming sulfide minerals, gunpowder, and sulfuric acid.

name: Nitrogen
extract: A colorless odorless inert diatomic chemical gas (N2) comprising seventy-eight percent of Earth's atmosphere.

name: Helium
extract: A colorless, odorless, non-toxic, inert noble gas, the second lightest element, glowing pale yellow in plasma.

name: Lead
extract: A heavy, dense, soft, malleable grey toxic metal element with a low melting point and high radiation shielding.

name: Mercury
extract: A heavy, silvery liquid transition metal element that remains liquid at standard ambient temperature and pressure.

name: Petroleum
extract: A naturally occurring yellowish-black viscous liquid mixture of hydrocarbons found in geological formations.

name: Methane
extract: A colorless, odorless, flammable hydrocarbon gas (CH4), the primary constituent of natural fossil fuel gas.

name: Ozone
extract: An inorganic molecule composed of three oxygen atoms (O3), forming a protective layer blocking UV rays in the stratosphere.

name: Graphite
extract: A soft, slippery crystalline allotrope of carbon with layered planar sheets conducting electricity well.

name: Ammonia
extract: A pungent, colorless alkaline gas compound of nitrogen and hydrogen (NH3), used in industrial fertilizers.

name: Calcium
extract: A reactive alkaline earth metal element (Ca), an essential chemical constituent of animal bones, teeth, and shells.
